notes.title: Waves 1.4.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Some bug fixes for the most common problems that aren't hardware or driver related.

[list]
[*]4k Resolutions supported in Video Settings.
[*]Optimized Trigger Area in Hold mode.
[*]All Ingame Music should now peak at the same volume.
[*]"Needs More Gun" Achievement should now unlock reliably.
[*]"Stop Touching Me!" description now matches unlock conditions.
[*]You now have an option to launch the game in Windowed mode.
[/list]

I've also changed how the Redists are handled to use Steams newer system. This is the first time I've used this system so I'm not sure what issues it may have. Hopefully none. The one thing to keep an eye out for is if you have to agree to a UDK EULA when starting the game. In theory this shouldn't happen but if it does please let me know.

notes.title: Update 1.4 - 16-03-2014 New Game Mode: Hold
notes.content:
A new free game mode has been added called "Hold".

In "Hold" your weapons are only available while you are inside the lit area.

Also as part of this update "Crunch Time" has been updated with some more spawn events, ambushes and mini-bosses from the other game modes as has been often requested by you; the fans.

notes.title: Update 1.3 - 10-02-2014 Kickstarter Promo
notes.content:
As part of the ongoing [url=http://kck.st/1cR9KUW]Kickstarter campaign[/URL] for the sequel to Waves I've released an update to coincide with it.

Update 1.3 includes two changes:

[list]
[*]A Message screen on the titles telling you about the latest update.
[*]The default weapon has been changed to the Beam Laser from the Sequel.
[/list]

You can switch back to the original weapon by unchecking "Promotional Weapon" in the Game settings screen.

This promotion will only run for the duration of the Kickstarter campaign after which the weapons will return to normal.

notes.title: Waves Update Released
notes.content:
Changes:
• Added "Ambient Mode" to Audio Settings. Once enabled all game sounds become musical instruments. Turn down the music and voice volume for maximum effect.
• This update will cause your graphics settings to reset to defaults.
